description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'ClientOutboundConnection' which manages client-to-gateway outbound connections in Orleans. It handles connection establishment, message sending and receiving, retries, and connection lifecycle management.

classes.name: ClientOutboundConnection
classes.description: Manages client outbound network connections, handling message I/O, connection lifecycle, and retries within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: RecordMessageReceive
methods.description: Logs metrics for a received message.

methods.name: RecordMessageSend
methods.description: Logs metrics for a sent message.

methods.name: OnReceivedMessage
methods.description: Dispatches a locally received message to the message center.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Main async loop for maintaining the connection, performing handshake, validating cluster ID, and handling exceptions.

methods.name: PrepareMessageForSend
methods.description: Prepares a message for sending, setting its target silo, or recycling if not valid.

methods.name: RetryMessage
methods.description: Retries sending a message up to a configured max retries, or fails it.

methods.name: SendRejection
methods.description: Sends a rejection message back to the sender with a specified reason.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles failures for messages, either rejecting or dropping them based on message type.

methods.name: OnSendMessageFailure
methods.description: Handles message send failures, resetting target silo and returning message to message center.
